name: Howell Gulf House - Beautiful 4BR Gulf Front Home
description: Welcome to Howell Gulf House! Your Gulf-front home away from home is located right on the sugar-white sand with expansive Gulf views in your backyard and tranquil Little Lagoon views in the front. With an updated open floor plan, four bedrooms, and four full bathrooms, this getaway sleeps 12 with all the comforts of home – except with an amazing Gulf Coast location.
